name.text: Finding mean, median and modal class for grouped data

questiontext.text:
The table shows daily rainfall (in mm) recorded at a weather station over {@N@} days. Complete the table, then use it to find the measures of central tendency. Round the mean and median to 2 decimal places.

Rainfall (mm)Frequency \(f\)Midpoint \(x\)\(fx\)Cumulative freq (CF)

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

Complete each column: midpoint \(x=\tfrac{\text{lower}+\text{upper}}{2}\), then \(fx\), and the running cumulative frequency:

Rainfall\(f\)\(x\)\(fx\)CF
{@lb[1]@}–{@ub[1]@}{@freq[1]@}{@midpts[1]@}{@fxs[1]@}{@cf[1]@}
{@lb[2]@}–{@ub[2]@}{@freq[2]@}{@midpts[2]@}{@fxs[2]@}{@cf[2]@}
{@lb[3]@}–{@ub[3]@}{@freq[3]@}{@midpts[3]@}{@fxs[3]@}{@cf[3]@}
{@lb[4]@}–{@ub[4]@}{@freq[4]@}{@midpts[4]@}{@fxs[4]@}{@cf[4]@}
{@lb[5]@}–{@ub[5]@}{@freq[5]@}{@midpts[5]@}{@fxs[5]@}{@cf[5]@}
Total{@N@}{@sum_fx@}

a) Modal class — the class with the highest frequency: {@modal_interval@}.

b) Mean

\[ \bar{x} = \frac{\sum fx}{\sum f} = \frac{ {@sum_fx@} }{ {@N@} } \approx {@mean_disp@} \text{ mm} \]

c) Median — the median class is \( {@lb[med_idx]@}\text{ - }{@ub[med_idx]@} \):

\[ \text{Median} = L + \left(\frac{\frac{N}{2} - CF}{f}\right)\times C \] \[ \text{Median} = {@L_med@} + \left(\frac{ {@med_pos@} - {@cf_prev@} }{ {@f_med@} }\right)\times {@cw@} \approx {@median_disp@} \text{ mm} \]
